original_ai_output.title_zh: 贡贝州议会通过州警察法案
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贡贝州议会一致通过支持设立州警察的法案，与国民议会的立场保持一致。据州议会信息委员会主席穆萨·布巴称，议员于周四作出该决定。目前该消息仅来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州议会一致通过支持设立州警察的法案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Gombe State House of Assembly has unanimously supported the establishment of state police, aligning its position with that of the National Assembly.

key_facts.fact: 州议会信息委员会主席穆萨·布巴披露该决定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Chairman of the House Committee on Information and member Ad Hoc Committee on State Police, Musa Buba, disclosed this shortly after the lawmakers reached the decision, on Thursday.

uncertainties: 该消息目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
正文为部分提取，法案具体条款与后续程序尚未明确
